from statistics import mean

MODEL_ID = "model_a"
MODEL_LABEL = "Model A · brightness OLS"
MODEL_DESCRIPTION = "Ordinary least squares FRP from same-time VIIRS I4 brightness; not a forecast."


def fit(rows):
    brightness_mean = mean(row["bright_ti4"] for row in rows)
    target_mean = mean(row["frp"] for row in rows)
    variance = sum((row["bright_ti4"] - brightness_mean) ** 2 for row in rows)
    covariance = sum((row["bright_ti4"] - brightness_mean) * (row["frp"] - target_mean) for row in rows)
    slope = covariance / variance if variance else 0.0
    return target_mean, brightness_mean, slope


def predict(fitted, brightness):
    target_mean, brightness_mean, slope = fitted
    return target_mean + slope * (brightness - brightness_mean)

import math


def test_wildfire_feature_general(client):
    report = client.get("/api/wildfire").json()
    assert report["dataset"]["train_rows"] > 0
    assert report["dataset"]["test_rows"] == len(report["predictions"])
    assert all(math.isfinite(value) for value in report["metrics"].values())
    response = client.post("/api/wildfire/predict", json={"brightness": 330})
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert math.isfinite(response.json()["prediction"])
